source: hand-picked palette for the mod tags in notable_weights.json; the vocabulary is the leaf tags the site shows, not the composite "X_damage"/"resource" tags mod-tag queries use
note: Colour groups follow the tag families the game uses to gate cluster notables: warm reds for damage, one hue per element, blues for mana/energy shield, greens for resistances, speed and poison. A tag colour is decoration only - it never changes an odds number.
